intent: Doorway nodes as DePIN CDN for static assets (fonts, icons, sophia UMD, HTML5 app ZIPs). Blobs are already content-addressed and served via /store/{hash}. Instead of build-time bundling, treat static assets as network content. Hybrid: bundle critical icon subset for bootstrap, load full set from doorway post-connection with SW caching. Shefa accounts for blob-serving bandwidth as measurable work. Prompted by font 404 bug in CI where fetch-fonts.sh was skipped.

Doorway dashboard 'Nodes' tab should always show 'this node' — the hardware the doorway is running on. This is device self-registration (imagodei concern), not orchestrator. The orchestrator is a separate elohim subagent that manages hardware-level concerns — on a cluster it balances compute across nodes (like a P2P k8s operator consuming shefa resource stats), but even on a single box it runs diagnostics, monitors disk/memory/thermal health, and could recommend hardware swaps. Same agent, different action space depending on topology. A doorway should be self-aware of its own node regardless. The health endpoint already has the data (conductor pools, workers). Clarify boundary: self-awareness = imagodei/doorway, hardware stewardship = orchestrator subagent (useful at any scale).

summary: Coordinator-zome drift heal in happ_manager (elohim-storage). Root-caused why the 2f02879d attestation fix never reached running conductors: a Holochain DNA hash covers only integrity zomes + modifiers, so a coordinator-only change leaves the bundle's DNA hashes byte-identical to the installed app and has_dna_drift is structurally blind to it. Added per-zome coordinator wasm-hash comparison (bundle DnaFile vs get_dna_definition) healed via update_coordinators hot-swap (no re-key, no DHT churn), gated by ALLOW_COORDINATOR_UPDATE defaulting to ALLOW_DNA_REINSTALL. Learner impact: fixes the community ships actually reach the people running conductors. Acceptance measure: existing genesis propagation.custody-convergence gate flipping green (no new a2o scenario; unit tests pin the hash invariant).

summary: Operator design rule for the commons resilience card: three-layer floor semantics — committed (DHT REA promises, durable denominator) / holding (shard custody, heals) / reachable (liveness, expected to churn). An EPR with 0 fresh peers but 10 committed peers is a community holding data ephemerally-unreachable, NOT unheld. feltStatus.floor must lead with the commitment layer (held by M of N committed, K reachable now); liveness only qualifies, never defines. Motivated live: stewarding flapped 0-1-0 on matthew under re-key because the felt story derives from the churn-fragile live join; also argues holding-layer identity should ride commitment/key lineage (2026-07-17 identity-head-key-lineage spec) not raw agent_cid equality.
learner_impact: A family sees 'three households promised to keep this safe, one is online right now' instead of a false 'nobody is holding these' during normal network weather.
